name: Hardened Peasant

effects.text: When flipped: this is [Protected] until end of turn.

flavor: The hard work of many peasants keeps the kingdom of Altaria fed.

effects.text: Sac a connected artifact: [Sidestep] [this] or target.

name: City Watchman
flavor: The cities of Altaria thrive under the rule of law, enforced by the royal guards of Her Majesty, Queen Brittany II.

effects.text: If a connected creature would take damage, [this] can take that damage instead.

name: Crafty Diplomat

effects.text: Inspire — Consume 1 mana: until end of turn, target creature is [Inspired] but cannot [Strike].

flavor: It was said that he could make an offer one couldn't refuse.

effects.text: Reprimand — Consume 1 mana: deal 1 damage to target creature.

name: Devout Priest

effects.text: When [this] collects mana: you can heal 1 damage from target.
Enlighten — Consume 1 mana: target collects 1 mana.

flavor: "Let the light of Galadon shine through me, and I shall be His tool."

name: Paladin of Hope

effects.text: Smite — During [this]'s [Strike] action; consume 1 mana: [this] gets +1 [Might] for this [Strike].

rulings: The Smite effect can be activated multiple times during the same [Strike] action.
flavor: "The Guild of Paladins still hoped that one day Theranor would return to lead them." — _A Brief History of Altaria_, p. 194

effects.text: While [this] [Strike | Strikes] a creature: [this] gets +1 [Might] and the blocker gets -1 [Might].
The mana on [this] cannot be consumed by means other than its own effects.
Indoctrinate — Transfer 1 mana from [this] to target or vice-versa.

name: Fishing Boat

effects.text: Rotate — Consume any 2 mana: rotate target.

flavor:
Altaria was renowned for its sprawling navy; the fishing boats
were the backbone of the kingdom's economy.

effects.text: Cannons — Deal 1 damage to target creature; then, target [Burst | Bursts].
When summoned: [Cleanse] and remove all damage, mana and attachments from target. It can act again during this event if it had already.

name: Towering Lighthouse

effects.text: Consume any 3 mana; choose a creature you control: chosen creature [Shift | Shifts] with target.

flavor: Scattered across the rivers and coast of Altaria there were lighthouses to guide the kingdom's vessels and spirits.

effects.text: Consume 2 mana: heal 1 damage and [Cleanse] chosen face-up creature.
Refresh — Discard a card: [this] collects 2 mana.
Consume any 3 mana then sac a non-[Blessed] face-up creature: summon.
Unholy Mace — [Strike] target; then, target [Burst | Bursts].

name: Righteous Knight of the Queen

effects.text: Sac a [Blessed] creature then consume any 3 mana: summon.
Protect — Consume 2 mana: destroy target artifact; then, if you did, this is [Protected] until end of turn.

flavor:
"To thee I pledge my sword, my life, and my soul;
your majesty; my Queen. All hail Queen Brittany II!"

effects.text: Absolve — [Pray]; then, you can deal 1 damage to target creature.
You can see any cards connected to [this].
Bless — Consume 1 mana: connected creatures are permanently [Blessed].
Sac at least 3 cards with at least 3 combined mana: summon.
When summoned: [this] or target creature is [Prone].
Corrupt — Consume 1 mana: until end of turn, [this] or target creature has [Weak] and [Evasive].

name: Sword of Theranor

effects.text: Consume any 1 mana from artifacts; sac 1 artifact: summon.

name: Church of the New Covenant

effects.text: Sac or discard at least 3 cards: summon; [this] collects the amount of mana on the sac'ed cards.
You can use mana on this card to pay for "non-any" mana costs.
If mana on a card would be lost due to it being destroyed, move that mana to [this] instead.

rulings: This replacement effect applies to all cards on the field.
In the event of multiple copies of [this], the one belonging to the controller of the card triggering the replacement event procs first (and wins).

name: Avatar of the False God, Galadon

effects.text: Sac at least 3 creatures with a combined mana of at least 7: summon.

flavor: They say to never meet your heroes.

effects.text: Learn — Move one mana from target to [this].

name: Poetic Ranger

effects.text: When [this] has fought with 2 different creatures: [Transform] [this].
Can only target a creature for a [Strike] if that creature has fought with [this] before.

flavor: The tips of his arrows were as sharp as his words.

effects.text: When [this] is targeted a second time by your opponent, after that effect resolves: [Transform] [this].
When it's the 2nd start of your turn since [this] was summoned: [Transform] [this].
Teach — Consume 1 mana: target collects 1 mana.

name: Gatherer of Dreams

effects.text: When connected to at least 3 Creature Tokens: [Transform] [this].

flavor:
Not only was she floating in dreams like dandelions;
she could gather the Fey to fulfill them.

effects.text: When [this] has visited all your creature zones: [Transform] [this].
When [this] declares a [Strike] against a creature; choose an attachment from it: destroy that attachment.
When [this] moves: you can destroy target artifact with no mana.
When summoned: you can deal 3 damage to target [Prone] creature.

name: Call of the Wild

effects.text: When summoned: sac two creatures; then, if you did, [Transform] target creature with [Transform]; the transformation is [Prone].

flavor: No Fey could resist hearing the unmistakable call of Nature herself.

name: Serenade of the Forest

effects.text: When summoned: target creature is [Protected] until the end of the turn; it collects 1 mana.

flavor:
The dulcet tones echoed through the forest,
as if sang by Mother Nature herself.

effects.text: When summoned; target all connected face-up creatures: for each target, it is [Prone]; or if it was already [Prone], it also has [Weak].

name: Morning Dew

effects.text:
When summoned; target all connected face-up creatures; for each target, choose either:
(1) [Cleanse] it;
(2) heal 2 damage; or
(3) collect 3 mana.

rulings: You must declare all targets and the choice for each on activation.

name: Forest Whispers

effects.text: When summoned: [Sidestep] target; then, if you did, it is [Suppressed].

flavor:
If you ignore the whispers, you might find yourself dead.
If you listen to them, you might find yourself mad.

effects.text: When summoned: deal 2 damage to all connected face-up creatures and collect 2 mana on all connected face-up artifacts.

name: Tiny Tree House

effects.text: Sac an artifact: chosen face-up creature is [Prone].

flavor: "They met in a tiny tree house, in which Theranor could barely fit. Luckily the atmosphere was amiable, so the paladins felt comfortable doffing their bulky outfits." — _A Brief History of Altaria_, p. 34

name: Secluded Fey Pond

effects.text: Heal — Discard a card: heal 1 damage from chosen face-up creature.

flavor: The big-lettered "FEY ONLY" on the sign had to later be prefixed with "non-transformed".

effects.text: Frighten — Discard a card: target has [Weak].
Maul — When a creature blocks [this]: that creature is [Prone].

name: Zion & Shawarma, Formidable Rats

effects.text: Tail Whip — Consume 2 mana: all connected face-up creatures are [Prone].
Shred — Sac up to 3 connected Scrolls: [this] collects 1 mana for each.

flavor:
One would be eternally grateful for the honor of
having met these incredible creatures.

name: Unavoidable Tremors

effects.text: When summoned: all face-up creatures are [Prone].

flavor: It was as if the entire forest was suddenly awake. And she was _not_ happy.

effects.text: Consume any 2 mana and sac 3 cards: summon.
[Prone] creatures with [Transform] can [Transform] at the end of each turn.

name: Mother Nature

effects.text: Revere — Consume any 3 mana: [Transform] target creature if it has [Transform]; then, either way, target is [Prone].

flavor: "I am all nature; nature is but me."
